items.title: Sharded remote pr-verification harness (test-efficiency workstream)
items.context: Lives entirely in the separate, fully user-owned pimmink/gsd-pi-ci harness repository, not in pimmink/gsd-pi — no upstream/fork PR is applicable. Adds .github/workflows/remote-pr-verification-sharded.yml, an experimental workflow_dispatch-only workflow that splits pimmink/gsd-pi's test:unit:compiled across 4 parallel shards using Node's native --test-shard=<index>/<total>, after independently validating locally (synthetic multi-glob fixture, exact production flag combination) that the flag must be placed before the glob patterns and is deterministic/complete/non-overlapping. Left the stable remote-pr-verification.yml completely untouched.
items.validation: Two real dispatches against pimmink/gsd-pi commit 28a2c92c3835e61f5fd19beffc6b8b4c6476bfc6 (fix/mai-cost-table-provider-section, historical GSD-W011/W014 spike commit, used only as a fixed measurement target). First dispatch (run 32015752880) failed fast and safely at an intentional file-count safety check (1274 actual vs an incorrectly hand-counted 1272 expected) before any shard ran. Corrective dispatch (run 32016308055) succeeded: all 4 shards + lifecycle-gate + aggregate green; aggregate totals across shards exactly matched the known unsharded baseline (14176 passed/0 failed/31 skipped), proving no test file was skipped or duplicated; total wall clock ~12m04s vs the 19m11s unsharded baseline (~37% reduction, run 31857969918). Merged to gsd-pi-ci:main (fast-forward, no PR needed for this private single-owner repo).
items.nextAction: None required to consider this workstream done. Optional future follow-up: consider promoting the sharded workflow from experimental to the primary remote-pr-verification path once used a few more times, and revisit shard_count if the real suite's size/composition changes materially.

items.title: Session-start GitHub Copilot catalog refresh and runtime model activation
items.context: Separate follow-up feature branch stacked on the W014 tip (W014 is not yet merged upstream). Adds an opt-in automatic refresh of the GitHub Copilot live model catalog at GSD session start, gated by a new copilot_catalog preference block (refresh_on_session_start: off|if_stale|always, default off; notify_on_changes default true; stale_after_ms default 6h). The coordinator reuses W014's existing fetch/last-known-good pipeline rather than duplicating it, is fire-and-forget only (never blocks ordinary startup), deduplicates concurrent triggers per basePath, applies a bounded timeout, and never triggers or waits on an OAuth/login flow. Also implements 3-tier runtime model classification (trusted / manual-only / quarantined) directly from the live CopilotModelRecord's availability/execution/billing/conflicts fields, without fabricating capability or pricing data. Wired into the session_start extension hook only. upstream/main advanced a FOURTH time (60f6919 -> c84f72b79f0bad21002be8d0988a912056e204a6), so W014 was rebased a fourth time and this branch was rebased onto the new W014 tip via `git rebase --onto`; git range-diff confirmed both feature commits content-identical again.
items.validation: A rebase mistake was made and immediately caught with zero downstream impact: the first --onto attempt used W018's own prior SHA as the oldbase argument instead of W014's prior tip, which produced an empty replay range and silently fast-forwarded to the new base, dropping W018's own 2 commits from the branch tip. Caught instantly via the standard post-rebase check `git rev-list --left-right --count <newbase>...HEAD` returning `0 0` instead of the expected `0 2` (documented in repo memory as a new gotcha). Fixed via `git reset --hard` to the just-created recovery ref, then redone with the correct oldbase (W014's actual prior tip, 4339e623c048f0289b717a38f9b01fa916358f44). Nothing was lost (recovery ref) and nothing bad was pushed (caught before the push step). After the fix: git range-diff confirmed both W018 commits content-identical across the fourth rebase; git merge-base origin/feat/github-copilot-model-catalog-sync HEAD equals 9c84c780a13f0a1ac1036600601a8a3dbdd33002 (0 behind, 2 ahead); pnpm run typecheck:extensions passed cleanly. GSD-W014's own fourth-rebase full-gate is pending; W018's own exact-SHA full-gate is not yet dispatched, per the required W014->W018->W017 order.
items.nextAction: Waiting on GSD-W014's own fourth-rebase full-gate (run 32663412416) to confirm green first, per the required W014->W018->W017 verification order. Once green, dispatch an exact-SHA remote full-gate for 886c4b41c3db3cb244de4ea6215c9f0771230b1d.
